title: Cursor: unify vscode-neovim entrypoint (cursor/nvim-init.lua vs lua/config/cursor.lua)
description: Two Cursor init paths exist: cursor/settings.json sets vscode-neovim.neovimInitVimPaths.darwin to cursor/nvim-init.lua (loads keymaps, dial, format.save_toggle), while init.lua checks vim.g.vscode and loads lua/config/cursor.lua (loads keymaps and format.save_toggle, missing dial). Also cursor/nvim-cursor.sh unsets NVIM_APPNAME so plugin/*.lua never autoloads when launched via nvim-cursor.sh, making the two paths drift.
design:
Pick one canonical Cursor entrypoint:
- Either have cursor/nvim-init.lua delegate to require('config.cursor') (or inline lua/config/cursor.lua into cursor/nvim-init.lua and have init.lua dofile/require the same module when vim.g.vscode is set), ensuring dial.nvim, keymaps, and format.save_toggle load identically in both paths.
- Document in AGENTS.md / comments whether plugin/*.lua vim.g.vscode guards are kept as defense-in-depth when init.lua is used without nvim-cursor.sh.
acceptance_criteria: Only one Cursor profile definition exists; dial, keymaps, and format.save_toggle load identically whether started via cursor/nvim-init.lua or init.lua with vim.g.vscode.

title: Runtimepath hygiene: root filetype.lua, after/ftplugin/*, and lsp/*.lua
description:
Adopt Neovim's native runtimepath conventions instead of scattered FileType autocmds, after/ftdetect fragments, and inline M.servers configs:
1. after/ftdetect/ has 3 real rules (ansible, gitlab, gradle) plus dead/unfinished files (go.lua sets global termguicolors; openapi.lua is a no-op stub; cloudformation.lua depends on uninstalled schemastore.nvim).
2. Buffer-local filetype setup is scattered across manual FileType autocmds in plugin/format.lua (markdown), lua/markdown_xanadu/init.lua (markdown), plugin/oil.lua (oil), plugin/rest.lua (http), and plugin/sql-dadbod.lua (sql + dead nvim-cmp check) — plus 45 lines of oil filetype branching embedded inside plugin/sidekick.lua (<leader>af).
3. lua/config/lsp.lua inlines per-server configs (lua_ls Hammerspoon on_attach, eslint, kotlin_lsp, bashls, dockerls, markdown_oxide) instead of Neovim 0.11+ native lsp/<server>.lua files.
design:
1. Consolidate ansible, gitlab, and gradle vim.filetype.add rules into a single root filetype.lua; remove after/ftdetect/{go,openapi,ansible,gitlab,gradle}.lua (and either drop or statically inline cloudformation if still wanted).
2. Move per-buffer filetype setup into after/ftplugin/:
   - after/ftplugin/markdown.lua: formatexpr + formatoptions+=t (from plugin/format.lua) and markdown_xanadu.setup_buffer(0).
   - after/ftplugin/oil.lua: buffer-local ~, <leader>y (from plugin/oil.lua), and buffer-local <leader>af to send oil entries to sidekick (simplifying plugin/sidekick.lua's global <leader>af to a 1-liner).
   - after/ftplugin/http.lua: buffer-local <CR> -> Rest run (from plugin/rest.lua).
   - after/ftplugin/sql.lua (plus mysql/plsql or shared helper): omnifunc = 'vim_dadbod_completion#omni' without dead pcall(require, 'cmp') (from plugin/sql-dadbod.lua).
3. Extract non-empty server configs from lua/config/lsp.lua into lsp/{lua_ls,eslint,kotlin_lsp,bashls,dockerls,markdown_oxide}.lua; keep M.ensure_installed, global vim.lsp.config('*', ...), lazydev, and LspAttach/keymaps in lua/config/lsp.lua.
4. Update AGENTS.md (and CLAUDE.md conventions section) so future changes follow these runtimepath conventions:
   - Root filetype.lua for vim.filetype.add rules (no after/ftdetect/).
   - after/ftplugin/<ft>.lua for buffer-local filetype options/keymaps (instead of FileType autocmds in plugin/*.lua).
   - lsp/<server>.lua for per-server LSP configs (instead of inline tables in lua/config/lsp.lua).
acceptance_criteria: Root filetype.lua replaces after/ftdetect/; after/ftplugin/{markdown,oil,http,sql}.lua replace manual FileType autocmds and untangle oil from plugin/sidekick.lua; lsp/<server>.lua files hold per-server LSP configs; AGENTS.md (and CLAUDE.md) document the runtimepath layout conventions; check-plugins and test-markdown-xanadu/test-format-markdown pass.
close_reason: Consolidated filetype.lua, moved FileType hooks to after/ftplugin/*, extracted lsp/*.lua, and updated AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md

title: Facets (Option 1): consolidate project tooling under lua/facets/ and decouple Playwright from lua/nx/
description: lua/facets/ was split across typescript/<tool>.lua detectors and <tool>/{run,trouble_source}.lua runners, while Playwright lived inside lua/nx/playwright*.lua with only a stub detector in lua/facets/playwright/e2e.lua. Consolidate all project-stack tooling under lua/facets/ and make lua/nx/ purely Nx monorepo scope/wizard code.
design:
1. Flatten and co-locate facet modules under lua/facets/:
   - lua/facets/eslint.lua (detect + Trouble runner + eslint LSP)
   - lua/facets/tsc.lua (detect + Trouble runner)
   - lua/facets/knip.lua (detect + Trouble runner)
   - lua/facets/kotlin.lua (detect + kotlin_lsp/gradle_ls + ktlint conform_formatters)
   - lua/facets/playwright/init.lua (detect + neotest-playwright adapter + DAP + .env.<cfg> picker, moved from lua/nx/playwright.lua & lua/facets/playwright/e2e.lua)
   - lua/facets/playwright/cli.lua (playwright test --help parser/cache/completion/picker, moved from lua/nx/playwright_cli.lua)
   - Delete lua/facets/{typescript,kotlin,eslint,tsc,knip}/ subdirectories and lua/nx/playwright*.lua.
2. Deduplicate Trouble sources and runners in lua/facets/trouble.lua:
   - Add M.make_source({ mode, source, desc, preview_title }) to replace the three 50-line trouble_source.lua files.
   - Replace run_eslint / run_tsc / run_knip with a single table-driven runner dispatch.
   - Update plugin/bqf-trouble-todo.lua to register sources via facets.trouble.
3. Share JSON reading via anchor.read_json(path) across facets and nx.workspace so facets do not depend on nx.workspace just to read package.json.
4. Decouple plugin/neotest.lua, plugin/dap.lua, and lua/nx/:
   - plugin/neotest.lua requires('facets.playwright') (zero nx.* imports).
   - plugin/dap.lua logs to dap-last.log with :DapLog (with :NxDapLog alias for muscle memory) instead of nx-dap-last.log.
   - lua/nx/execute.lua and lua/nx/review.lua call require('facets.playwright') / require('facets.playwright.cli') when target == 'e2e'.
5. Update AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, lua/facets/README.md, lua/nx/README.md, and docs/specs/2026-10-22-project-facets-design.md.
6. Test plan (automated in test/facets_spec.lua + test/nx_spec.lua, wired into test/run.sh):
   - Registry loads all 5 facets (typescript.eslint, typescript.tsc, typescript.knip, playwright.e2e, kotlin.jvm) with zero load warnings.
   - Facet detection on synthetic temp repos (Node+ESLint+tsc+Knip+Playwright, Gradle+Kotlin) activates expected facet IDs, LSP specs, conform_formatters, and trouble_choices.
   - Parsers: eslint.parse_json_results, tsc.parse_output, knip.parse_json produce valid trouble.Item lists.
   - Trouble sources: facets_eslint, facets_tsc, facets_knip are registered in Trouble and modes facet_eslint/facet_tsc/facet_knip exist.
   - Playwright facet: is_pw_spec, find_pw_config_dir, dotenv merging, and cli.parse_help / cli.minor_version / cli.complete work standalone without nx.json.
   - Boundary check: plugin/neotest.lua, plugin/dap.lua, and lua/facets/playwright/* have no require('nx.*') calls (except optional fallback to project.json / git root).
acceptance_criteria: All 5 facets consolidated under lua/facets/; lua/nx/playwright*.lua and 3x trouble_source.lua removed; test/facets_spec.lua added to test/run.sh and passing.
close_reason: Consolidated all 5 facets under lua/facets/, moved Playwright out of lua/nx/ into lua/facets/playwright/, deduplicated Trouble sources, and added test/facets_spec.lua

title: Fix nx show projects failing in Neovim
description:
Symptom: Nx picker shows '237 projects loaded — nx show projects failed (saved glob fallback)'. UI resilience is largely done (async refresh, glob fallback, path_index/hydrate to avoid select hang). Remaining work: make nx CLI succeed in Neovim subprocesses, not just survive failure.

Diagnosis (cwd ruled out — glob finds 237 projects under correct root):
1. Node not on PATH in GUI/Cursor Neovim (most likely) — nx wrapper exists but #!/usr/bin/env node fails
2. Nx daemon bad state — retry with NX_DAEMON=false for read-only queries
3. Nx plugin/graph errors — need stderr surfaced
4. npx fallback worse in bare GUI env

Do NOT: sync nx on picker open, more glob, cache glob as nx-success.

Verify from failing workspace:
:lua print(vim.inspect(vim.system({'node','-v'},{text=true}):wait()))
:lua local r=require'nx.workspace'; local w=r.root(); print(vim.inspect(vim.system(r.nx_cmd(w,{'show','projects','--json'}),{cwd=w,text=true,env=vim.fn.environ()}):wait()))
